cases.name: etaf-ext-manifest-validation-matching-and-per-app-policies
cases.purpose: Manifest validation rejects invalid specs; Runtime matching reacts to metadata updates and respects persisted per-app allow and deny policies.

cases.name: etaf-ext-strict-permission-gating-on-context-primitives
cases.purpose: Every permission-gated context primitive signals etaf-ext-permission-error when the extension manifest omits its required capability.

cases.name: etaf-ext-isolated-sqlite-storage-and-memory-fallback
cases.purpose: Per-extension KV storage isolates namespaces across extensions, persists via SQLite WAL when available, and degrades cleanly to in-memory storage.

cases.name: etaf-ext-shared-tree-cache-circuit-breaker-and-pure-mode
cases.purpose: Host tree snapshots share across extensions per commit revision, consecutive failures trip the circuit breaker and clean up without affecting siblings, and Pure Mode hides and restores extensions cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-ext-multi-owner-decorate-companion-overlay-and-theme
cases.purpose: Independent extensions coexist across decorate, priority-ordered companions and root overlays via public etaf-ext primitives and tear down independently.

cases.name: etaf-ext-manager-ui-opens-filters-toggles-and-closes-cleanly
cases.purpose: etaf-ext-manage opens with preserved mode-line targeting a live Runtime, reflects extension key layers in etaf-help-data, syncs live enablement changes, and disposes cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-ext-key-conflict-firewall-overrides-and-unified-dispatch
cases.purpose: Key resolver blocks global-prefix, global-key, printing-char and lower-priority extension conflicts, executes commands through the unified two-step prefix dispatcher, enforces keybinding policies, and persists user overrides.

cases.name: etaf-ext-activity-and-notify-bridge
cases.purpose: Extensions publish runtime-scoped live activities that auto-clean on detach and route etaf-ext-notify through etaf-notify.
